overloads.semanticRole: Reads the contents of the disk file fileName into a text result, applying character-set decoding and end-of-line normalization.

constraints: fileName can be a bare file name (resolved next to the structure file), a pathname relative to the structure file, or an absolute pathname; the file must exist or an error is generated (caught via ON ERR CALL).
If the document has a Byte Order Mark (BOM), the BOM's character set is used instead of charSet, which is then ignored.
If there is no BOM and charSet is omitted, the default is ANSI on Windows and MacRoman on macOS.
breakMode defaults to native line-break format (1) when omitted; other values (0=unchanged, 2=CRLF, 3=CR, 4=LF) are documented constants in the System Documents theme.
Does not modify the OK system variable; failures raise a catchable error instead.
